lines.differs: Worse for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: payment term is 60 days instead of 45 days.
Worse for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: payment term is 60 days instead of 30 days.
Worse for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: payment term is 60 days instead of 30 days, with no late interest clause.
Worse for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: 1% total fee per week capped at 15% instead of 0.5% milestone fee capped at 5%.
Better for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: liquidated damages are 1% per week capped at 15% instead of 1% per day uncapped.
Worse for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: liquidated damages apply to total contract fees rather than only the affected milestone fees.
Worse for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: deliverables vest upon creation rather than upon full payment.
Worse for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: AtliQ transfers deliverable IP on creation instead of retaining ownership of work product IP.
Same as Brightwater Insurance Inc: deliverables vest on creation while pre-existing materials are licensed.
Worse for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: unilateral confidentiality lasting 5 years post-termination instead of mutual confidentiality for 2 years.
Worse for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: unilateral confidentiality lasting 5 years post-termination instead of mutual confidentiality lasting 3 years.
Worse for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: unilateral confidentiality obligation lasting 5 years post-termination instead of mutual confidentiality.
Worse for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: broad unilateral indemnity for all losses instead of mutual indemnity limited to specified third-party claims.
Worse for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: broad unilateral indemnity covering all losses instead of indemnity limited to third-party IP claims and negligence.
Worse for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: broad unilateral indemnity for all losses instead of mutual indemnity limited to specified third-party claims.
Worse for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: AtliQ's liability is uncapped while client liability is capped at 3 months, instead of mutual 12-month caps.
Worse for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: AtliQ's liability is uncapped instead of being capped at 12 months of fees.
Worse for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: AtliQ's liability is uncapped while client is capped at 3 months, instead of mutual SOW fee caps.
Worse for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: unilateral 12-month non-solicit of client employees instead of a mutual 6-month non-solicit.
Worse for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: restricts AtliQ from soliciting client employees instead of restricting the client from soliciting AtliQ personnel.
Worse for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: court litigation in Hyderabad instead of dispute resolution by arbitration in New Delhi.
Worse for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: direct court jurisdiction in Hyderabad without prior mandatory negotiation or arbitration in Pune.
Better for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: governed by Indian law and Hyderabad courts instead of Ohio law and Ohio courts.
